name: Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct GGUF (Q4_K_M)
description: Small vision-language model. The selected GGUF requires its matching multimodal projector file for image input.
manualSteps: Open the repository Files and versions page at the source URL.
Manually download Qwen3VL-2B-Instruct-Q4_K_M.gguf.
Manually download mmproj-Qwen3VL-2B-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf from the same repository.
Place both files together under Models/vision/Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct/.
Click Add / Detect Models, then select the model and its projector.
notes: Upstream repository license metadata is Apache-2.0; this does not independently verify the provenance of a local file.
Runtime support was tested with llamafile 0.10.6 on Windows. Other architectures require separate validation.

name: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B GGUF (Q8_0)
description: 0.6B multilingual text-embedding model. The embeddings endpoint returned a 1,024-dimensional vector in the project owner's test.
manualSteps: Open the repository Files and versions page at the source URL.
Manually download Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0.gguf.
Place it under Models/embedding/.
Start the model with the embeddings option enabled and configure the embedding service endpoint.
notes: The project owner verified that the model returned a 1,024-dimensional embedding using llamafile 0.10.6 on Windows.
Controller integration should be verified separately; this entry records the standalone runtime test.
License metadata and exact file provenance should be rechecked against the upstream repository before redistribution.
